title: Create: Crafts & Construct
description: Create-Mod addon that adds a paint system, more recipes and more stuff to the game!
body:
![Crafts & Construct Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2deaa10753f9ce50fe840fc747da8764854b6b78.png)

**Crafts and Construct is an Create-Addon designed to enhance your engineering builds with a custom painting system, new decorative blocks, Food and items.** 

Whether you want to organize your factory piping with color-coded materials, build custom industrial machinery, or grow your own crops for sweet treats, this mod adds a variety of useful features to the base Create experience.

![Stripe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d652d8d2ebd2a536f3e7538f35de8774c0c693e1.png)

### Community and Feedback

This mod is active in development! We are constantly working on new items, blocks, and gameplay improvements. If you want to suggest new features, report bugs, or share your designs, feel free to join us.

* [Our Discord Server](https://discord.gg/XcCSSqDg8X)

![Stripe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d652d8d2ebd2a536f3e7538f35de8774c0c693e1.png)

### The Painting System

The core feature of Crafts and Construct is the custom painting system. By using the **Paint Gun**, you can apply different materials to your Create blocks to change their appearance and style. Currently, the mod support three primary industrial themes:
* **Andesite**
* **Brass**
* **Sturdy** (formerly known as Train)

#### How to use:
1. Craft an **Empty Paint Cartridge**.
2. Fill it by crafting it with the desired material (Andesite Alloy, Brass Ingot, or Sturdy Sheets).
3. Place the loaded **Paint Cartridge** in your off-hand.
4. Hold the **Paint Gun** in your main hand and shift-right-click on any compatible block.

#### Compatible Blocks:
You can paint a wide range of fluid-handling and mechanical components from the Create mod:
* Fluid Pipes
* Smart Fluid Pipes
* Fluid Valves
* Valve Handles
* Fluid Tanks
* Spouts
* Hose Pulleys
* Steam Engines
* Steam Whistles
* Portable Fluid Interfaces
* Item Drains

![Painted Block Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7474213d2ffd1be8c3fe5a27d095225a3f7c43f.png)

![Stripe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d652d8d2ebd2a536f3e7538f35de8774c0c693e1.png)

### Textile Blocks & Decoration

Bring comfort and style to your factory floors, train stations, and living spaces with Create-themed textile blocks. 
* **Standard Textile Blocks:** Available in all 16 Minecraft colors.
* **Checkered Textile Blocks:** Perfect for adding patterns and tiling.

_CURRENTLY CREATIVE ONLY_

![Textile Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e125bdfd4be60117ecbf4e5dec0f5756a4f502f.png)

![Stripe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d652d8d2ebd2a536f3e7538f35de8774c0c693e1.png)

### Gummy Bears & Agriculture

Take a break from heavy automation and dive into candy making.
* **Sugar Beet Farming:** Cultivate Sugar Beets using the new **Sugar Beet Seeds**. Use your harvest to make sugar or craft delicious **Gummy Bears**.
* **Gummy Bears:** Available in 5 different colors (Green, Yellow, Red, Pink and Blue).

![Gummy Bears and Jelly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a17cfb51c7d8d2c39414cd541b8fbd002e8324d.png)
